subject: prd/planner-driven-model-routing
statement: For every implementation and review routing attempt, the system shall record either the frozen plan/v2 assessment, derived profile, evidence citations, and policy version or a typed no-rewrite plan/v1 origin containing the original rung presence/value, compatibility-table version, translation classification, and translated profile; it shall also record the selected harness and role, connected task/proposal identity, and an `exact`, `promoted`, or `unsupported` resolution, with native profile identity on resolved routes.
rationale: operators and successor routing need one complete routing decision without pretending legacy plans contain fields they never froze
fit_criterion: every attempt links by `demand_id` to exactly one EVT-1 or EVT-8 origin and by `attempt_id` to exactly one EVT-2 or EVT-3 terminal; plan/v1 explicit-rung, absent-rung, retry, and review fixtures remain unambiguous, every EVT-2 has a native profile, every EVT-3 has none, and source plan bytes remain unchanged
